newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Gauze sees 950,000T cocoa output, 800,000T exports.
newsitem.headline: Gauze sees 950,000T cocoa output, 800,000T exports.

text.p: Cocoa production in the Ivory Coast will reach between 900,000 and 950,000 tonnes in the October/September 1996/97 season, Commodity Minister Guy-Alain Gauze said on Wednesday.
He told Reuters in an interview cocoa exports will be about 750,000 to 800,000 tonnes, with the rest going to local consumption.
"Even if you have one million tonnes, you have to take out the bad quality beans. That's why we are talking between 900,000 to 950,000 tonnes," Gauze said in an interview.

The ICCO estimated earlier this month that the Ivory Coast, the world's biggest cocoa producer, will harvest a crop which will reach 1.125 million tonnes. One broker has even placed the crop at 1.15 million tonnes.
"This is still our position, 900,000 to 950,000 tonnes. People are talking about 1.1 or 1.2 (million tonnes). I feel that is not correct," Gauze said.
